Reference Blocks and High-Quality Accessories for Your Testing Equipment 
The right accessories for hardness testing devices are essential to achieving precise and reliable measurement results. At Bareiss, we offer a wide range of accessories for hardness testers, specifically designed to optimize the performance and accuracy of your testing equipment. Among them are our reference blocks, which play a key role in calibration and quality control. 
Reference blocks are indispensable when it comes to regularly verifying hardness testers and ensuring they meet the required standards. They provide a known hardness value and allow you to check the accuracy of your hardness measurements. Bareiss reference blocks are known for their exceptional precision and durability, ensuring that your test results remain consistently accurate and dependable. 
In addition to reference blocks, we offer a variety of other accessories for hardness testers that simplify and enhance the testing process. These include specialized test fixtures, adapters, spare parts, and other components that expand the usability and functionality of your testing devices. Each accessory is designed for seamless integration with your existing equipment while maintaining the highest standards of quality and performance.
